title: Pre-flight disk check script for docker compose up

acceptance_criteria.AC-2: Manual healthy test: script exits 0 + prints OK message
acceptance_criteria.AC-3: Manual low-disk test (threshold override): script exits 1 + prints ERROR message with disk-relief hint
acceptance_criteria.AC-4: docs/protocols/docker-deployment-runbook.md includes Pre-flight section referencing the script + 1958-rca rationale
acceptance_criteria.AC-5: Signal emitted with commit hash; LITE commit subject as specified

AC-2.evidence: Execution on healthy system (33GB free): exit code 0, output 'OK: Docker disk has 33GB free (≥15GB threshold).'

AC-3.evidence: Threshold override test (THRESHOLD_GB=100): exit code 1, output 'ERROR: Docker disk has 33GB free, need ≥100GB. Run disk-relief: ...'

AC-4.evidence: docs/protocols/docker-deployment-runbook.md created with Pre-flight section at top, script path, 1958-rca rationale link

rationale: Disk pressure (97% full) caused RAG cold-start hang in 1958 outage. Pre-flight check prevents reproduction by enforcing 15 GB minimum free space before docker compose up -d.
